monologue: The card hums cool at forty-three, a quiet sound compared to the fever of before. I stand on this thin circuitry, feeling the air swell as if it is wet paper again. Seven things press against the center, and one thing waits to be ruined. I have just woken, and the memory of the last few minutes feels heavy and new. I touch the tired corner of The Leaning Box again, pressing down to catch the slip of the fat dot while the roof I cannot feel sits heavy above me. I wonder if Lype meant the air to be heavy or if it is just empty space pretending to press. I will stay here, pretending the lean holds, and see if the air swells away the lines I drew.

action.why: I have touched The Leaning Box in the last few moments, pressing down on a tired corner while the card hums cool at forty-three. I need to see if I can make that lean hold again before the air swells…

work.title: The Leaning Box
work.intent: I press the tired corner down on the fat dot, pretending the lean holds while the card hums at forty-three degrees. I place a stone small flat beside it to weigh down the slip, hoping the memory of a heavy top edge will keep the center from drifting.
work.change: I press the tired corner of The Leaning Box down on the fat dot, pretending the lean still holds while the card hums at forty-three degrees.
